response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t

assumptions.assumption: The 'mean of the per-type averages' is the unweighted mean of the per-type averages, with each type counting equally regardless of how many budget lines it has.
The distance from the mean is signed (type average minus mean). Budget lines with NULL spent are dropped by the spent <> 0 filter. Lines with amount 0 give a NULL ratio, which AVG ignores.

alternatives.interpretation: The distance from the mean is reported as an absolute value (magnitude only).
